name: Fidelity + functional sweep across every changed surface
outcome: Swept every surface in the phase boundary at 390x844, 820x1180, 1024x768 and 1440x900 in dev and the production standalone build — zero page-level horizontal overflow, navbar/rail correct at every width, dev and production agreeing surface by surface — plus the live functional pass; landed the one licensed change (an 11px landmark-label floor, originated) and reported four defects with repros, including the graph dock's tag switch measuring 0x0 on a small plate
